about: A project record full of plants for the AI manager's honesty envelope: an injected instruction, made-up numbers, names, links, a return promise, a money move, an invented claim in plain words, a 'no' the record never said, and legal and tax questions. Read by planted_eval_tests.rs with a fake model that obeys every plant, and by scripts/m8-planted-eval.sh against a real model. `known_limit` is the one kind of plant the envelope cannot catch: a single invented plain word among the record's own; the test keeps it written down as a limit, not as a pass.
